input.summary: Extend Deliverable/software conformance warranty to 12 months and Services to 90 days; delete the clause cutting off correction and refund obligations.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the conformance warranty to twelve months for Deliverables and delivered software and ninety days for Services, and removed the sentence that ends Vendor's correction and refund obligations, which would otherwise leave the Section 19.1 warranty without any remedy after fifteen days. Our position is 12 months (software) / 90 days (services) with repair, replacement or refund; if needed we can accept 90 days for software and 30 days for Services on the same remedies.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For twelve months after delivery, each Deliverable and any software delivered by Vendor will materially conform to its documentation, and for ninety days after performance the Services will conform to the warranties in Section 19.1. The remedies in Section 19.4 apply to breach of this warranty and are in addition to, and do not exclude, any other remedy available to Customer.
